module.name: RSS feed
module.description: Shows the headlines of an RSS or Atom feed (text only). The server fetches the feed; the player keeps the last known state offline.

allowed_hosts.title: Allowed domains
allowed_hosts.description: List of allowed domain names. Empty: any public https host is accepted.

refresh_min.title: Refresh (min)
refresh_min.description: Interval between two fetches of a feed (5 minutes minimum).

max_bytes.title: Maximum feed size (bytes)
max_bytes.description: A larger feed is refused (2 MiB at most).

url.title: Feed address
url.description: https address of an RSS 2.0 or Atom feed. Feeds on a private network are not reachable.

item_duration_s.title: Time per article (s)
item_duration_s.description: In list mode, the item duration is the number of articles multiplied by this time.

max_age_s.title: Maximum age (s)
max_age_s.description: Beyond this, when offline, data is considered stale and the item is skipped.

content_rss.same_origin: The address points to the VDS server itself.
content_rss.invalid_show_date: Invalid value for the date display.
